newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank sees leeway for dividend rise.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank sees leeway for dividend rise.

text.p: Commerzbank AG said on Tuesday that it did not rule out an increase in its dividend in the future after having left its 1996 dividend unchanged at 1.35 marks per share despite a strong rise in operating profit.
"Certainly in the case of a good result there could be leeway," chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen told a news conference.
He added that Commerzbank on principle wanted an equal distribution between its dividend payout and its allocation to its earnings reserves.
"The allocation to these reserves in 1996 was 650 million marks compared to a dividend payout of 540 million marks. From this you can draw whatever conclusion you wish."
